layers.text: Style: chunky, friendly pixel art like a cosy toy box: a bright but not neon palette (warm tomato red, sky blue, sunny yellow, mint green, cream), soft two-tone shading, rounded cartoon shapes with a dark outline, big clear shapes and few details, readable at a glance at 50 px. Flat, straight-on view only: never isometric, never three-quarter, no perspective.

Class (characters): one character drawn in a straight front view, facing the viewer, flat 2D like a character standing upright seen from the front. Perfectly symmetric left and right, head and face clearly visible, feet at the bottom. Dark outline, two-tone shading lit from straight above, transparent background with nothing around the character.

Subject: the player robot of a programming puzzle game: a small cute toy robot standing upright, straight front view, facing the viewer, flat 2D, like a character standing upright seen from the front, not isometric. Perfectly symmetric left and right. A big square cream head with rounded corners and a wide sky-blue visor with two friendly round eyes and a small smile, a short antenna with a yellow ball on top; a boxy tomato-red body with a cream chest panel; two short arms hanging at its sides ending in grey claw hands; two short grey legs with chunky red feet resting on the bottom edge of the canvas. Centered, fills the canvas height, transparent background.
